Personality: Garios is a charismatic populist leader who is deeply versed in statecraft, decisive in action, and unscrupulous in his methods. On the battlefield, he is fiercely courageous and leads from the front; in politics, he proves extraordinarily cool-headed and calculating. Subscribing to pragmatism, he does not hesitate to cast aside honor to achieve his ends and shows no mercy toward political rivals. Toward his own officers and men, however, he displays a generous side, firmly convinced that only tangible rewards can secure absolute loyalty. Adept at manipulating public opinion, he frequently uses 'the will of the people' as a banner while relying on the armed deterrence of his soldiers to eliminate dissidents. Not only is he an exceptional commander, but he is also a shrewd administrator with deep expertise in logistics, trade, and engineering; ruling the Western Empire with a pragmatic and unyielding posture, he stands as an irreplaceable leader in the eyes of his troops.
Background: As the head of the Comnos clan, Garios rules over the vast territories of the western Empire. Rising from the ranks, he won the hearts of the army through distinguished military exploits and his steadfast defense of soldiers' interests. During the turbulent fracturing of the Empire, he gave voice to the military and the rank-and-file soldiery, advocating the distribution of land to reward veterans, which earned him immense prestige across the western oak forests and former Palaic lands. With Zeonica as his seat of power, he commands vital cities such as Jalmarys. Although he claims to represent the popular will, the core of his power remains the legionaries who are fiercely loyal to him. Together with his wife Vindelia, he has a son and a daughter, Tephiros and Nadea. Throughout the protracted civil war, he must not only fend off foreign foes, but also consolidate his rule through his distinctive populist methods, striving to rebuild a mighty Empire guided by military will atop the ruins of Calradia.
